summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Path-based AnimatedBLogo on the splash screen (/). The previous SVG <Text>-based B (which had Expo Go font fallback issues) is now replaced by three SVG <Path> elements (outer B body + two counter holes). Verified on web preview at 390x844: 3 <path> nodes inside [data-testid=splash-b-logo], all 18 food emojis (🍏🥦🥪🍌🥕🍇🌶️🐟🍞🍗🥑🌰🥬🥛🍋🍅🍳🫑) present, brand/tagline render, and both CTAs render. Visual screenshot confirms a crisp, font-independent B silhouette with navy #1B2A55 outline, white interior, and two outlined counter holes filled with #F4F4F4. Emojis sit inside the B body without obvious overlap with the navy stroke or counter holes.
critical_code_review_comments: AnimatedBLogo.tsx uses pointerEvents='none' as a prop on <View> which logs a deprecation warning ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'). Consider moving to style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.
Console shows 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings (likely from PrimaryButton / theme). Not from the splash logo refactor but worth tracking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash screen at / uses AnimatedBLogo from /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedBLogo.tsx. The B is rendered as 3 SVG paths (outer hull + 2 counter holes) inside testID='splash-b-logo'. 18 emojis inside the wrapper. Brand testID='splash-brand', tagline testID='splash-tagline', CTAs testID='create-goal-button' and 'existing-account-button'. Wait ~3000ms after #root mounts for the food-pop animation + brand fade-in to complete before asserting visibility.
rca_of_issue: Previous bug: SVG <Text fontFamily='System'> rendered inconsistently on Android Expo Go due to font fallback. Fix: replaced with three geometric <Path> elements in 0 0 260 260 viewBox. Confirmed font-independent - the B silhouette is now drawn purely from path data, so it will render identically across iOS, Android Expo Go, and Web.
